lines: I should get back to reading the water before the weather turns.
The nets will not mend themselves. Good talking with you.
I have bait in the sun, so I had better move.
There is a tide coming in. I want the boat tied before it arrives.
I promised myself a hot meal before dark.
The gulls are circling my barrel again. I should check it.
I need to rinse the salt from my gear.
That wind has changed. I am going to look at the moorings.
I left a knot half finished down by the dock.
The river is dropping, which means the traps need moving.
I should bring the catch in before the cats notice it.
My line needs drying before I coil it away.
There is still enough daylight to check the far bank.
I have a hook to sharpen and no desire to do it by lantern light.
The clouds over the water are getting darker. I should go.
A pot is waiting for this fish, and I am getting hungry.
I need to patch the boat while the boards are dry.
The morning catch will come early. I should get some rest.
I hear loose rope knocking against the dock. That will bother me until I fix it.
Take care. Wet stone gets slippery after sunset.
